text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I, Dantsu Flame, will be running in the 
Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running back-to-back from the Yasuda Kinen 
to the Takarazuka Kinen drew massive 
attention, just as planned—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ngh, yay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame placed high in the fan 
voting, earning herself priority entry 
into the Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list:
With this momentum, let's head for the 
Yasuda Kinen first!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a clear tailwind behind us, we 
arrived at the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... U-Umastagram is blowing up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umastagram screen she held out was 
filled with positive reactions, such as 
numerous comments and stamps.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I was so moved watching the Niigata 
Daishoten live at the track!" "Looking 
forward to seeing you in the Yasuda 
Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I've been watching you since the Classic 
campaign. The Senior year belongs to 
Dantsu Flame"...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. It's the first time we've 
had this much of a response, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To have this much expected of me is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, aah! Somehow, somehow, 
somehow...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: We've got to give it our all, haven't we?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(The Yasuda Kinen is a race packed with 
mile specialists...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(If I don't face this with full resolve 
and give it everything, I won't be able to 
live up to these expectations!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll show you I can do it—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I won't let down the expectations everyone 
has placed on me! I promise I'll shine 
brighter than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't even manage that much, I'll 
never be able to become the star...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the wind at their backs, the curtain 
rises on the Yasuda Kinen!
